title: Leo Music Studio v10.6.3 - Docked Smart AI Side Panel, 4 New Circle Designs & Typo-Tolerant AI Edition
highlights: Docked Leo AI Side Panel on Homepage (320px right dock, NOT full-screen) that smoothly hides or unhides when clicking the Leo AI Circle
4 Brand-New Vector Leo AI Circle Designs: Siri Silk Ring, Google Halo, Cyber Neon Pulse, and Minimal Glass Gem
Leo AI ON/OFF Toggle & Circle Style Selector in Settings (persisted in user_settings.cfg)

High-Smart Fuzzy & Typo-Tolerant AI Engine: understands half-written words and wrong spellings across ALL AI tasks ('paly', 'whtsp', 'msg', 'yt', 'chtgpt', 'ad nte', 'dwnld', 'volm') and fuzzy-matches half/misspelled song names ('paly strby' -> Starboy, 'ply kesrya' -> Kesariya)
Decluttered Clean Studio UI: streamlined Top Bar (3 sleek pills), Hero Banner, and Track List rows
Persistent Local Offline Storage in Leo_Music_Local_Data\Downloads & downloads_catalog.db
